## Import and preview the dataset

```{r}
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(caTools)

student_scores <- read_csv("data/student_scores.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
head(student_scores)
```

## Explore the data

```{r}
dim(student_scores)
summary(student_scores)
cor(student_scores)
```

```{r}
ggplot(student_scores, aes(x = Hours, y = Scores)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Scores)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "orange", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Study Hours and Student Scores")
```

## Create the regression model

```{r}
set.seed(42)
sample_split <- sample.split(student_scores$Scores, SplitRatio = 0.7)
train_set <- subset(student_scores, sample_split)
test_set <- subset(student_scores, !sample_split)

model <- lm(Scores ~ Hours, data = train_set)
summary(model)
```

## Examine model residuals

```{r}
model_residuals <- data.frame(residual = residuals(model))

ggplot(model_residuals, aes(x = residual)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "#68A9CF", color = "black") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Model Residuals")
```

## Compare predicted and actual scores

```{r}
predictions <- predict(model, test_set)
results <- data.frame(predicted = predictions, actual = test_set$Scores)
results
```

## Predict the score for 9.25 study hours

```{r}
new_student <- data.frame(Hours = 9.25)
predicted_score <- predict(model, new_student)
predicted_score
```
